basis: The 54-leaf Linux V11 journey used a 15-minute duration and 512 MiB post-warmup growth ceiling; its recorded duration was 703,027.593 ms. The current 55-leaf journey adds a real Volicord A-to-B-to-C Work continuity leaf with eight B/C Analysis Snapshots. Its first clean-HEAD run passed all 55 leaves and measured 1,026,151.145 ms and 763,064,961 bytes of post-warmup growth. The new workload allowance is five minutes for the B/C analysis and interaction sequence and eight times 36 MiB for retained snapshots, giving 20 minutes and 800 MiB. This budget applies only to the named workload; the 4 GiB RSS, 2 GiB manifest and logical storage, 2.125 GiB physical storage, 90-second RPC, and 2,048-byte-per-graph-item ceilings remain unchanged. The original 48-file storage fixture measured 691,245 logical bytes and 332,517 bytes of unchanged growth after normalization, compared with 1,656,908 and 828,454 bytes before it; these regression checks remain in force.
